name: radar_fields_rift_audited_v2

data.dataset: named RIFT collection object; resolve with --object

objective.target_construction: coherent frequency response -> IFFT -> squared magnitude -> train-only normalized dB
objective.renderer: bistatic native bin-center solid-angle ray mean including zero exterior samples
objective.occupancy_target: per-pair range median plus original Bayesian recurrence
objective.unsupported_roi_cells: retained in whole-ROI loss and reported separately

resources.sizing_basis: Unmeasured for audited-v2. Existing 80 percent readout headroom gate only; no scheduler resource authorization.

readout.valid_region: at least one ray sample lies inside registered support
readout.geometry: direction-independent occupancy on the declared compatibility grid

limits: The 8000-step clock is retained as a development starting point, not a convergence claim.
Permutation coverage gives every training view two exposures and 1600 views a third exposure at the default budget.
No measured sensor antenna pattern or coherent interference prediction is introduced.
GOTCHA requires a separate native backend; this protocol applies only to the RIFT collection.
The legacy production protocol remains unchanged and cannot validate this recipe.
